nodes.label: Language Session
nodes.intent: Preserve one bounded language-work identity and its validated resumable state across commands and restarts.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An Entity model is not an implemented aggregate, persistence guarantee, owner admission, or accepted Runtime Contract.

nodes.label: Language Question
nodes.intent: Preserve one stable, visible question about meaning, evidence, conflict, scope, ownership, or disposition inside one session.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not the business Language Question, a rendered prompt, or a second source of meaning.

nodes.label: Language Answer
nodes.intent: Preserve one explicit authored response, correction, refusal, or deferral for one exact question without inferring authority.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not a suggestion, inferred context, owner acceptance, or canonical meaning.

nodes.label: Definition Pack Candidate
nodes.intent: Preserve one identified unaccepted output with dispositions, evidence, owners, typed relations, visible residue, and authority effect none.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not an accepted Definition Pack, canonical definitions, Design approval, or successful Define outcome.

nodes.label: Language Session State
nodes.intent: Carry the complete validated state consumed and returned by the pure session transition calculation.

body.equality: Two Language Session States are equal only when every declared field is equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: Not the Session identity, store, event log, or proof of completeness.

nodes.label: Language Session Command
nodes.intent: Preserve one identity-bearing explicit typed request at an expected revision with actor, target, payload, and provenance so an exact retry can be distinguished from a new command.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Stable command identity supports exact retry recognition; it is not a transport message, answer, owner decision, accepted command, or proof of idempotent execution.

nodes.label: Language Question View
nodes.intent: Carry the read-only projection of the active question with stable identity, revision, meaning, evidence, owner, status, and allowed command semantics.

body.equality: Two Language Question Views are equal only when every declared field is equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: Not a CLI screen, chat message, Question Entity, mutable state, or second question truth.

nodes.label: Candidate Artifact Preview
nodes.intent: Carry one deterministic unmaterialized preview and its digest without claiming review, acceptance, or filesystem emission.

body.equality: Two Candidate Artifact Previews are equal only when every declared field is equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: A draft preview is not a materialized candidate, review, acceptance, publication, or proof of correctness.

nodes.label: Candidate Review Binding
nodes.intent: Bind explicit review to one session identity, revision, state digest, and preview digest so output-affecting change invalidates the review.

body.equality: Two Candidate Review Bindings are equal only when every declared field is equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: Review is not owner acceptance, definition promotion, publication approval, or evidence that the candidate is correct.

nodes.label: Session Revision
nodes.intent: Bind one validated state to a monotonic revision and exact state digest.

body.equality: Two Session Revisions are equal only when revision and state digest are equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: A revision does not prove durable storage, serializability, or concurrent-writer safety.

nodes.label: Authority Envelope
nodes.intent: Carry allowed uses, blocked effects, owner routes, and challenge routes without granting authority.

body.equality: Two Authority Envelopes are equal only when every declared field is equal.

nodes.forbidden_inference: Visibility, participation, evidence, ownership, recommendation, and authority remain distinct.

nodes.label: Language Command Kind
nodes.intent: Name the six command meanings admitted by the candidate Language Session Command definition.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Enum membership does not prove every command transition has an accepted Runtime Contract or implementation.

nodes.label: Question State
nodes.intent: Name the explicit visible states used by the candidate question lifecycle.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A state value is not a transition, owner decision, answer, or lifecycle proof.

nodes.label: Evaluate Session Transition
nodes.intent: Deterministically evaluate one validated state and one explicit command into rejection or one validated next state plus Question View or no-active-question, without hidden I/O.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Calculation node is not an executable kernel, persistence operation, Runtime Contract, or evidence of determinism.

nodes.label: Build Candidate Preview
nodes.intent: Deterministically derive a draft Definition Pack preview from one validated session state while preserving every visible unresolved matter.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Preview calculation does not materialize, review, accept, or publish a candidate.

nodes.label: Open Language Question
nodes.intent: Create one stable Language Question selected by the validated transition result without inventing owner or evidence references.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An Operation node is not an implemented transition or proof that question selection is correct.

nodes.label: Record Language Answer
nodes.intent: Create one explicit Language Answer for the exact current question while preserving actor, provenance, and authority effect separately.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Recording an answer does not accept it as canonical meaning or an owner decision.

nodes.label: Change Question Disposition
nodes.intent: Apply an explicit defer, withdraw, or challenge command to the exact current question while keeping the unresolved matter visible.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Changing disposition does not resolve, answer, close, or erase the underlying matter.

nodes.label: Review Candidate Preview
nodes.intent: Record explicit review of one exact preview against its session identity, revision, state digest, and preview digest.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Review recording is not materialization, acceptance, promotion, or publication authority.

nodes.label: Persist Session Transition
nodes.intent: Validate expected revision and atomically replace the prior valid local JSON state under the one-process, one-writer experiment boundary.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not crash, power-loss, filesystem, database, distributed, or concurrent-writer durability.

nodes.label: Materialize Definition Pack Candidate
nodes.intent: Create one candidate output only when exact review binding and required-concept visibility rules pass.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Materialization is not acceptance, canonical promotion, Design approval, publication, or successful Define completion.

nodes.label: Load Language Session
nodes.intent: Read the last validated committed state for one session without mutation or reconstruction of missing answers.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Query model is not restart evidence or a guarantee that stored bytes are recoverable.

nodes.label: Read Current Question
nodes.intent: Read the active question and deterministically project the transport-neutral Language Question View without mutation.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not a CLI renderer, chat adapter, or second state owner.

nodes.label: Valid Session Command Rule
nodes.intent: Allow a session-changing command only when its session, actor, kind, target, payload, provenance, and explicit-versus-inferred posture are valid for the current state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A valid command is not an accepted answer, owner decision, or authorized external effect.

nodes.label: Expected Revision Rule
nodes.intent: Allow persistence only when the command expected revision equals the last committed session revision.
nodes.forbidden_inference: This single-writer guard is not a general concurrency or transaction model.

nodes.label: Idempotent Command Rule
nodes.intent: Require the same command identity and payload digest to return the prior confirmed outcome rather than apply the same state change twice.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A modeled retry rule is not proof of exactly-once execution or safe retries across processes.

nodes.label: Exact Review Binding Rule
nodes.intent: Allow candidate materialization only when review binds the exact session, revision, state digest, and preview digest and remains current.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Review does not imply owner acceptance, canonical promotion, or correctness.

nodes.label: Required Concept Disposition Rule
nodes.intent: Allow materialization only when every goal-required concept has one visible reuse, specialize, propose, or open disposition and unresolved matters remain present.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Visible coverage is not proof that open-ended human intent is complete.

nodes.label: Language Session Workflow
nodes.intent: Coordinate question work, answer/disposition recording, review, persistence, and bounded candidate materialization inside one feature.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Workflow node does not implement orchestration, retry, scheduling, or authorization.

nodes.label: Language Session Kernel Interface
nodes.intent: Expose the candidate Layer-0 session operations and read-only question projection without choosing CLI, chat, IPC, HTTP, or process topology.
nodes.forbidden_inference: An internal Interface model does not select a transport, runtime, or implementation package.

nodes.label: Language Session Repository Interface
nodes.intent: Expose load and validated compare-and-replace behavior for the first local JSON experiment without selecting a backend.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Not a database, event store, IPC endpoint, distributed lock, or durability proof.

nodes.label: Session Persistence Mapping
nodes.intent: Map the in-memory validated Session representation to and from versioned local JSON without changing identity, meaning, evidence, owners, or residue.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A Mapping node is not a serializer implementation, migration proof, or storage selection.

nodes.label: Language Session Lifecycle
nodes.intent: Represent that the visible session state advances only through recorded transition, rejection, review, and materialization outcomes.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A State Machine node does not prove allowed transitions are complete, implemented, or observed.

nodes.label: Session Transition Persisted
nodes.intent: Record that one validated next state crossed the candidate single-writer commit boundary at an exact revision and digest.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A modeled event is not runtime evidence that persistence occurred.

nodes.label: Session Command Rejected
nodes.intent: Record that one stale, invalid, corrupting, or unsupported command did not replace the last valid state.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A rejection model is not evidence that every invalid command fails closed in an implementation.

nodes.label: Candidate Preview Reviewed
nodes.intent: Record that one reviewer explicitly reviewed an exact state and preview digest tuple.
nodes.forbidden_inference: Review is not owner acceptance, definition promotion, publication, or correctness.

nodes.label: Definition Pack Candidate Materialized
nodes.intent: Record that one reviewed Definition Pack candidate was materialized with residue and authority limits intact.
nodes.forbidden_inference: A modeled materialization event is not evidence of an actual file, accepted pack, or successful Define outcome.
